sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Civil Servants Amendment Act 1991
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1991
ACT III OF 1991
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE CIVIL SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Civil Servants
Act, 1973
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 26th March, 1991]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/91/5126, dated 26-3-1991.---The
North-West Frontier Province Civil Servants (Amendment) Bill, 1991, having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the
12th March, 1991 and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier
Province on 21st March, 1991, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and commencement. (1) This Act may be called the
North West Frontier Province Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

ACT III OF 1991
ACT III OF 1991
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE CIVIL SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Civil Servants
Act, 1973
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 26th March, 1991]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/91/5126, dated 26-3-1991.---The
North-West Frontier Province Civil Servants (Amendment) Bill, 1991, having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the
12th March, 1991 and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier
Province on 21st March, 1991, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of section 13 of N: W.F.P. Act XVIII of 1973.--In the
North-West Frontier Province Civil Servants Act, 1973 (N.-W.F.P. Act XVIII of
1973), for section 13, the
following shall be substituted, namely:
"13. Retirement from service.---A Civil Servant shall
retire from service on the completion of the sixtieth year of his age."
